translations.web: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;
translations.bsb: both parties to the dispute must stand in the presence of the LORD, before the priests and judges who are in office at that time.
translations.kjv: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;
